units.source_text: 即使眼前发生地震，她肯定也不会相信的。

en.t: Even if an earthquake happened right before her eyes, she surely would not believe it.

units.source_text: 即使世界崩溃，也许谁有这个女人不会崩溃吧。

en.t: Even if the world collapsed, perhaps this woman alone would not collapse.

units.source_text: 因为鞠子只相信事件是按自己的思路发生的。

en.t: Because Mariko believed only that events happened according to her own line of reasoning.

units.source_text: 可是，世界不可能按鞠子的想像那样崩溃啊。

en.t: But the world could not possibly collapse in the way Mariko imagined.

units.source_text: 鞠子是决没有考虑这种事的机会的。

en.t: Mariko had certainly never had the chance to think about such a thing.

units.source_text: 在这一点上，鞠子很像柏木。

en.t: In this respect, Mariko was very much like Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 鞠子就是女人中不考虑自己思路以外的事的柏木。

en.t: Mariko was Kashiwagi in female form, someone who never considered anything outside her own line of reasoning.
